title: Proposal: working together on SOS1-related disorders research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into SOS1-related disorders.
We are writing to the RASopathies Network because you support families affected by RASopathies, including SOS1-related Noonan syndrome.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
SOS1 changes are reported to work by gain of function, where the protein does too much.
Relevant registries include the PATRAS registry in Europe and your own contact registry.
A clinical and genetic study of RASopathies is recruiting, as are a natural history study of RASopathy cardiomyopathy and a phase 2 trial of MEK inhibitors for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
The Baby MERIT phase 3 trial is not yet recruiting, and several of these records enrol by syndrome without naming SOS1.
A contested point: off-label trametinib rests on a single case report and has no completed randomised trial.
We would propose a study on [research question about SOS1-related disorders], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how your contact registry or community might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
